title: Ensemble Rainfall-Runoff Analysis (ERRA) Python Package
description: Python implementation of Ensemble Rainfall-Runoff Analysis (ERRA) for estimating runoff response distributions by regularized deconvolution, including nonlinear, non-stationary, robust, multi-driver, and plotting workflows.

creators.name: Kirchner, James W.
creators.affiliation: ETH Zurich and Swiss Federal Research Institute WSL

notes: This release archives the public ERRA Python package. Restricted China gauge series, catchment polygons, and third-party data are not part of this software release.
